summary: __thiscall accessor that reads the dword contact/event flag at this + 0xBC (this[47]), clears it to zero, and returns the prior value. A read-and-clear pattern for a one-shot event/contact flag. Existing analysis places a call from InitViewportDimensions during viewport initialization.

operations.description: Read the flag at this[47] (offset 0xBC) into result.
Clear the flag: write 0 back to this[47] (offset 0xBC).
Return the prior flag value captured before the clear.

clean_pseudocode: int result = this[47];  // this + 0xBC, contact/event flag
unresolved: The object type owning the flag at offset 0xBC is unknown; the flag is supplied by caller InitViewportDimensions and its exact event meaning is unconfirmed.
